name: DukePorne
source:
You play as Duke, who will be guided through the night by your decisions on what he should encounter and how he should go about it!

[From [url=https://mrtomatoesquire.itch.io/dukeporne]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演杜克，带他度过这一夜。他会碰上什么，又会怎样应对，都由你来决定！
